fourier_target_relative_l2.method: Paired percentile bootstrap; identical sampled physical indices across both roles and every species; common finite pairs, retaining finite negative-temperature failures in absolute-error vectors
fourier_target_relative_l2.interpretation: Conditional sampling uncertainty for the frozen estimators; excludes retraining/selection uncertainty. Macro means weight species equally. Ratios compare means, not mean per-sample ratios.

notes: Model input/output statistics come from each own real training checkpoint.
Shape metrics use canonical float32 inverse Fourier targets; global R2 is flattened against one grand mean.
Original-VDF L2 uses float64 inverse reconstruction of unchanged float32 coefficients on original float64 axes.
Temperature truth is manifest actual temperature. all_finite errors include finite negative temperatures; nonfinite/negative counts are separate.
True-Fourier direct integral bias and fixed Taylor3 estimator bias are reported separately.
Paired CIs use common finite pairs. Ratio is selected mean error divided by baseline mean error; positive absolute improvement means baseline minus selected.
Representative examples independently choose median and worst Fourier-target error for each role.
No training, PV, clipping, renormalization, post-test weight adjustment, or method selection occurred. The frozen physical-Fourier average is the declared selected ensemble.
Mixture weights were fixed before evaluation. The fixed-wide training run is incomplete; complete-pipeline budget eligibility is unknown. Evaluation uses its selected frozen checkpoint.
